newsitem.title: USA: San Francisco area home sales surge 36 pct - report.
newsitem.headline: San Francisco area home sales surge 36 pct - report.

text.p: San Francisco Bay area home sales surged 36 percent in March while strong demand continued to push prices higher, according to a report issued on Wednesday.

A total of 4,895 resale houses were sold in the nine-county Bay area in March, up 36.1 percent from 3,596 for February and up 5.5 percent from 4,642 for March a year ago, Acxiom/DataQuick Information Systems said in the report.
"While available inventory is getting thin in some areas, there's still a balance between supply and demand in most markets," Mike Ela, DataQuick president, said in a statement.
The median price paid for a home in the Bay area was $236,000 in March, up 3.5 percent from $228,000 for February and up 2.2 percent from $231,000 for March last year, the report said.
The report was based on home sales in the counties of Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano and Sonoma.
